pkgmetadata.longdescription: rebar-sources provides the Gentoo kernel sources plus additional out-of-tree PCI patches that make the kernel's "pci=realloc=on" boot option able to reallocate resources behind PCI bridges whose own BARs would otherwise pin an upstream prefetchable window in place. This is required to get Resizable BAR / large BAR relocation working for devices such as Intel Arc GPUs on platforms (e.g. Lenovo P920, Intel C621 chipset) whose firmware does not natively enable Resizable BAR.
